verdict.rationale: Community users praise JQL and running queries over Jira data via REST, which is evidence of a real structured search capability over tasks. However, no first-party docs describe search, one user calls building a useful saved search painful, and several report Jira as slow in general. Missing for 10: documented cross-content search spanning tasks, docs (Confluence) and comments, evidence of fast search performance, evidence of result accuracy/relevance, and first-party search documentation.
